summary: OceanFirst Financial Corp. filed an 8-K announcing Federal Reserve approval of its acquisition of Flushing Financial Corporation via merger sub under a December 29, 2025 agreement. No price per share, premium, or value is disclosed. The board recommends the transaction; advisors are not named. State and OCC approvals were previously received; no further regulatory approvals are needed. The closing is expected by June 1, 2026, pending remaining conditions. The filing also includes notice of OceanFirst's 2026 annual meeting. What to watch: final closing conditions and shareholder vote; the risk-arb spread will narrow as the closing date approaches.
